description: Find publicly listed contact emails for YouTube channels and creators.

channels.description: YouTube channel URLs, @handles, UC... channel IDs, or video URLs (mode=channels). Video URLs resolve to their channel.
channels.title: Channels

emailDomains.description: Optional list of domains to keep, for example brand.com or gmail.com. Leave empty to keep every discovered email.
emailDomains.title: Email domain allowlist

includeVideoDescriptions.description: Read the descriptions of the latest five videos on each channel.
includeVideoDescriptions.title: Scan recent video descriptions

includeWebsite.description: Visit up to two linked websites (home, contact/about pages and common paths) and one link-in-bio hub per channel.
includeWebsite.title: Scan linked websites and link hubs

maxChannels.description: Maximum number of unique channels processed per run, across both modes.
maxChannels.title: Max channels

maxEmailsPerChannel.description: Upper bound on the emails returned for each channel. The highest-value public contact is chosen as primaryEmail.
maxEmailsPerChannel.title: Max emails per channel

mode.description: Choose whether to scrape the channels you provide or discover channels from search queries.
mode.title: Mode

onlyWithEmail.description: When enabled, channels with no public email are left out of the dataset. Error records are still reported.
onlyWithEmail.title: Only channels with a public email

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy; set this only when your runs need a specific Apify Proxy connection.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQueries.description: Keywords used to discover channels through YouTube search (mode=search). Each query returns up to about 20 channels; duplicates and maxChannels are applied across queries.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

title: YouTube Email Scraper Input
